title: Polk County History Museum

services.name: Dentist Exhibit
services.desc: This dental display once belonged to Dr. Charles S. McCall, 1888-1963, a popular dentist in Forest City, NC for 50 years. Charles had four sons and he, “talked them all into becoming dentists, too.” One of his sons, Charles William McCall, opened a practice in Tryon moving several times from upstairs over Owen’s Drugs
